name: Athlete
body:
An athlete dominates not through subtlety, but through physical prowess. They increase their physical ability scores, base attack bonus, hit dice, and saving throws as they advance.

Role: An athlete is a martial specialist who excels at physical challenges, athletics, and direct combat versatility.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d10.

Starting Wealth: 5d6 x 10 gp (average 175 gp). In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class skills

The athlete’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Escape Artist (Dex), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks per Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Table: Athlete

Class Features
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

An athlete is proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not with any shields or medium or heavy armor.

Determination (Ex)

At 1st level, an athlete may re-roll one failed dice roll per day. The athlete must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse. At 5th level, and every 4 levels thereafter (9th, 13th, 17th, and 20th), the athlete can use this ability one additional time per day.

Position (Ex)

Everyone has a position or role on a team, and an athlete learns his own better than any. At 1st level, and again at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level, the athlete selects or upgrades a tactical team position that grants bonuses to himself and adjacent allies in combat.

Sport (Ex)

An athlete is trained in a variety of sports. At 1st level (professional) and at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level, the athlete chooses a sport specialization that grants competency bonuses to physical skill checks and athletic maneuvers.

Strive (Ex)

An athlete may use his athlete level as his base attack bonus for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites.

Training (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, an athlete gains a +2 inherent bonus to one physical ability score (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution). He gains an additional +2 inherent bonus to a physical ability score at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

Bonus Feats: At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter (8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th), an athlete gains a bonus feat selected from combat feats or feats that modify athletic skills.

Evasion (Ex)

At 8th level and higher, an athlete gains evasion.

Clutch (Ex)

At 10th level, an athlete can take 10 on any skill that is listed as a skill bonus for a sport they are trained in, even when threatened or under duress.

All-star (Ex)

At 20th level, an athlete can take 20 on any skill that is listed as a skill bonus for a sport they are trained in once per day as a standard action without increasing the time required.
